segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Ananya
segments.text: Hello! This is Ananya from Sunrise Clinic. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Priya
segments.text: Hi, I'd like to see a dermatologist this week, if possible.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Ananya
segments.text: Of course. Dr. Rao, our dermatologist, has openings tomorrow at eleven thirty in the morning, or at five in the evening. Which one works for you?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Priya
segments.text: Eleven thirty is perfect.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Ananya
segments.text: Lovely. May I have the patient's name, please?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Priya
segments.text: Priya Menon.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Ananya
segments.text: Thank you, Priya. You're booked with Dr. Rao tomorrow at eleven thirty. The consultation fee is eight hundred rupees. Is there anything else I can help with?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Priya
segments.text: No, that's all. Thanks!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Ananya
segments.text: You're welcome. See you tomorrow, and have a lovely day!

blurb: Qualifies property enquiries and books site visits.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Rohan
segments.text: Hi Arjun, this is Rohan from Skyline Homes. You enquired about our Baner project. Is this a good time for a quick chat?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Arjun
segments.text: Sure, go ahead.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Rohan
segments.text: Great. Are you looking at a two BHK or a three BHK?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Arjun
segments.text: Two BHK. My budget is around ninety lakhs.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Rohan
segments.text: That works well. Our two BHK homes start at eighty-five lakh rupees, with possession in December twenty twenty-seven. When are you hoping to buy?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Arjun
segments.text: Probably in the next three months. I'll need a home loan.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Rohan
segments.text: No problem, we work with several banks and can help with the loan. Shall I book a site visit this Sunday at eleven?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Arjun
segments.text: Sunday at eleven works.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Rohan
segments.text: Done. You're booked for Sunday at eleven. I'll send the location shortly. Thanks, Arjun!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Simran
segments.text: Hi Vikram, this is Simran from the TalentBridge hiring team. You applied for the Customer Support Executive role in Bengaluru. Is this a good time to talk?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Vikram
segments.text: Yes, absolutely.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Simran
segments.text: Great. How many years of customer-facing experience do you have?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Vikram
segments.text: About two years, at a telecom call centre.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Simran
segments.text: That's helpful. And what's your current notice period?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Vikram
segments.text: Thirty days.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Simran
segments.text: Perfect. Are you comfortable speaking with customers in both Hindi and English?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Vikram
segments.text: Yes, I use both every day.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Simran
segments.text: Wonderful. I'd like to schedule your interview. Would Thursday at eleven in the morning or three in the afternoon suit you better?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.name: Vikram
segments.text: Three in the afternoon, please.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.name: Simran
segments.text: You're all set for Thursday at three. You'll get the details by email. All the best, Vikram!
